sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release

system.description:
You mold clay, earth, or another inorganic earthen substance into three birds of your description. These birds then soar towards a target within range, ignoring cover. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack, dealing 3d10 force damage and forcing affected creatures to make a Strength saving throw on a hit. On failed save, affected creatures are knocked Prone and Dazzled.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage by 1d10. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can target the same creature up to twice per casting.
